                              sample.id="S5", assembly="hg38",
                              read.context="CpG", save.folder="C:/Users/kalyani_patankar/Desktop/S5/methCall")

library(genomation)

gene.obj = readTranscriptFeatures(location = "C:/Users/kalyani_patankar/Desktop/S5/DMPK.bed")

annotate.WithGenicParts(myobj, gene.obj)

DMPK.bed is a bed file obtained from UCSC genome browser

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-8ZLFNcJ6NcU/WwbqG5-tZCI/AAAAAAAAAlw/oZxOgT31g88vmF4B8yFPKQcelNyeqEaaACLcBGAs/s1600/Capture.JPG>

Error in annotate.WithGenicParts(myobj, gene.obj) :
  unused arguments (myobj, gene.obj)

How Can I resolve this?

Thanks In Advance
